parts.title: Who drives ROBIN
parts.body: People submit runs from the CLI today; the API will give web apps like SoundHub the same operations.

parts.title: The record
parts.body: The run manager keeps every run, task and outcome in PostgreSQL: on a laptop in Docker, or on Amazon RDS.

parts.title: Run manager
parts.body: Keeps the record of all work: what was requested, on which recordings, with which settings, and what came out. It makes every result traceable and prevents duplicate work.

parts.title: Inference engine
parts.body: Runs any model the same way: reads audio, splits it into windows, runs the model, checks the output, and writes scores, detections and embeddings.

parts.title: Comparison module
parts.body: Measures how well models perform against expert labels, compares models against one another, and picks the clips experts should label next.

parts.title: Fine-tuning engine
parts.body: Trains a small classifier head on a backbone model (BirdNET, Perch) using a program's own labels. The new head runs like any other model.

parts.title: Shared contracts
parts.body: The files and formats every part of ROBIN agrees on: what a model reports about itself, what a run request contains, and what a result contains.

parts.title: ROBIN core
parts.body: The same core runs everywhere. It only talks to the outside world through its five ports, so a result means the same thing on a laptop as on AWS.

parts.title: Catalog port
parts.body: Resolves which recordings to process: from a folder layout, an S3 bucket prefix, a sheet, or the SoundHub API (via the small soundhub-robin adapter).

parts.title: Storage port
parts.body: Reads and writes audio, work files and results, on local disk, S3, or other cloud storage.

parts.title: Governance port
parts.body: Checks whether a proposed use is permitted and records what each recording is used for, following the rules of the deployment: fully open, CDFW, or an Indigenous partner's agreement.

parts.title: Compute port
parts.body: Launches jobs, stops them and checks their status: on a local machine, AWS SageMaker, a Slurm cluster, or Kubernetes.

parts.title: Inference models port
parts.body: Connects the inference engine to model-specific code: BirdNET, Perch, the PNW Spotted Owl model, or a custom classifier head.
